summary:
Bullpen is the category to trust right now, and R4 is the rating riding it hardest — R4 bullpen is 94-67 (58%) over the last 14 days, well clear of every other cell on the board, while trends across all four ratings has cooled into a 3-game losing streak despite still owning the best combo numbers (trends+sp 56.7%, trends+runs 56.2% season-long). R4 also leads every rating in strong-play production over the last 14 days at 35-24 (+16.0u) and matches R2's blistering 7-day clip, so when R4 diverges from the pack today, lean its direction. Runs is the one to fade — R4 runs is cold at -5.3pts off baseline, and R1-R3 runs are all sitting under .500 in the 14-day window (48%, 48%, 49%), so any pick that's living or dying on the runs category alone deserves a discount today.

On the slate, LAD @ CIN is the top signal — full four-rating consensus on LAD with the largest average delta of the day (R3 -3.44, R1 -3.25), and LAD is the best team-when-liked play in the sample at 32-14 (70%) straight and a monster 24-5 (83%, +27.0u) when it's a strong play. That's about as clean as it gets. ATH @ TBR is the second-strongest consensus (R4 all the way up at +2.55 on TBR) and TBR is money when picked, 36-16 (69%) with strong plays going 22-9 (+18.0u) — pair that bullpen strength with TBR's profile and it's a green light. BOS @ TEX is worth a flag despite being a thin consensus (-0.47 to -0.32 across all four) because BOS is elite when liked at 39-16 (71%, strong 22-7 +19.0u); don't let the small delta scare you off a proven team side. Where the model actually disagrees — SDP/COL, MIA/ARI, DET/TOR, ATL/CHC — treat as pass-or-small plays; R2 and R4 are the outliers flipping sides on three of those four splits, and with runs and hitting both running cold across the board (R1 hitting 47%, R2/R3 hitting 48%), there's no category edge to break the tie.
